theme: Myth-busting: common misconceptions about mutual funds, addressed simply
headline: Mutual Funds: Separating Fact From Fiction
body: Mutual funds aren't just for the wealthy. They're accessible investment vehicles that pool money from many investors, professionally managed for diversification.
caption: A common myth: you need lots of money to start investing. Reality: most funds accept modest amounts from regular investors. Investing is about consistency, not lump sums. #MutualFundMyths #InvestmentTruths #SmartInvesting #DebunkingMyths #LongTermWealth
